original.target_description: Study 1: normalised posterolateral Y-Balance reach on dominant stance limb; Greenhouse-Geisser repeated-measures ANOVA comparing final pre-fatigue and 0, 10, 20 min post-fatigue measurements.

n.sample_role: Male and female university student participants engaged in competitive sport; analytic n appears to be the enrolled 20, with no later exclusions reported.
n.exclusions: Eligibility exclusions: chronic ankle instability; vestibular/visual impairment; recent lower limb injury; cardiovascular/neurological disease; balance disorders/medication; PAR-Q yes; not competitive sport. No analysis-stage exclusions reported.
